highResTransform.description: Shopify CDN: images are served as base files under /cdn/shop/files/. Add ?width=2400 query param to request max resolution. The declared img width/height attributes on the element indicate 2400x2880 original dimensions.
highResTransform.name: width

notes: Color swatches on the product page are <a> tags linking to entirely separate product URLs (e.g. /products/...-black-2bf14 vs /products/...-lemonade-2bf14). Each color is a distinct Shopify product handle — clicking triggers a FULL page reload. On the listing page, color radio inputs (.color-option input[type='radio']) do an in-place card image swap without URL change. On the product page, all gallery images are in the DOM on page load in a 2-column CSS grid (.product-gallery__carousel, display:grid, 2 cols). First 2 images are eager-loaded; images 3–8 are lazy (loading='lazy') and revealed by scrolling — no click needed. Thumbnail navigation (product-gallery-navigation button.product-gallery__thumbnail) exists in the DOM but is hidden on desktop (display:none on  .product-gallery__thumbnail-list); it appears on mobile. Clicking any gallery image opens a PhotoSwipe (.pswp) lightbox with prev/close/next buttons (.pswp__button) and click-to-zoom. Pagination uses numbered pages with AJAX: URLs update to ?page=N, href='#' on pagination <a> tags. Platform confirmed as Shopify (myshopify domain: aubade-int.myshopify.com), theme uses custom elements (variant-picker, product-gallery, product-card). No active bot protection observed during browsing session (captcha-bootstrap script present but not triggered).
